newsitem.title: USA: Micronetics sees one-time gain of $0.03.
newsitem.headline: Micronetics sees one-time gain of $0.03.

text.p: Micronetics Wireless Inc said Thursday it will post a one-time gain of $0.03 per share, or about $100,000, for FY97.
The company said it was awarded more than $1.2 million from the Aetna Casualty & Surety Co after a November 1994 flood damaged its facilities and inventory.
The company initially received payments of $387,000 during FY95, resulting in a one-time gain that year of $51,283 or $.02 a share, it said.
